in_sanskrit.name: दीपिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Deepa means 'light' in Sanskrit. Ikha means 'base, foundation'. Together, Deepika means 'the base of light' or 'illumination'.

in_hindi.name: दीपिता
in_hindi.meaning: दीप का पालन, समर्थन करना (to protect, support the light)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Deepita is a Hindi name derived from Sanskrit 'Deepa' meaning 'light'. It can be interpreted as 'the one who protects or supports the light'.

in_tamil.name: திப்பிதா
in_tamil.meaning: இலக்கையில் இருந்து இல்லாமல் இலக்கையை வெளியிடும் (to let light enter into a place where there is no light)
in_tamil.long_meaning: Tipitha is a Tamil name. It can be interpreted as 'the one who lets light enter into a place where there is no light'.

in_telugu.name: దీపిథా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Dipitha is a Telugu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning 'light'. It is also considered to be the name of the Goddess of Light.

in_marathi.name: Deepitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deep: Represents depth and wisdom. Abode: Symbolizes a peaceful and spiritual dwelling place.

in_bengali.name: Deepitha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Deep, Abode
in_bengali.long_meaning: Deepitha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deep: Represents depth and wisdom. Abode: Symbolizes a peaceful and spiritual dwelling place.
